Sean,

Chiming in — from prior SOC2 audits, auditors will accept reports from reputable independent firms even if they're not CREST-accredited, as long as you provide the following extras:

- Engagement letter (shows scope and independence)
- Lead tester CVs or short bios to demonstrate expertise
- Signed testing attestation from the vendor (dates, scope, exclusions)
- Evidence mapping: vulnerability ID -> JIRA ticket -> PR that fixes it -> verification screenshot (timestamped)

Aditya — I can draft a one-page vendor credibility statement to accompany the redacted report. For the JIRA screenshots, please include issue timestamps and the merge commit hash in the PR. Also ensure any screenshots obscure internal IPs and customer data.
